name: Battle of Hillsbrad
label: Quest
description: This campaign order from High Executor Darthalia directs Horde agents to strike deep into Azurelode Mine, a vital iron excavation south of Hillsbrad…
intro: This campaign order from High Executor Darthalia directs Horde agents to strike deep into Azurelode Mine, a vital iron excavation south of Hillsbrad Fields. By eliminating Foreman Bonds and his crew, the Forsaken aim to sever iron shipments to Alliance armories and seize the tunnels for themselves.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Hillsbrad Town Registry indicates that the Azureload Mine is under Alliance control. Furthermore, the mine is a prime source of iron ore for the Alliance armories.
Even though we've struck a decisive blow to the town of Hillsbrad, the Alliance still supports and protects the Azureload Mine fervently.
The mine lies due south of Hillsbrad. Go there and slay the foreman, a human by the name of Bonds. Kill his miners as well. That should send a clear message to the Alliance.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You were given direct orders to attack the Azureload Mine. Your reasons for loafing about Tarren Mill better be good or I will behead you for treason.

clips.title: Completion
paras: The Dark Lady will be pleased when she learns that she has a new mine from which she can arm her soldiers.
